content:
maria_cs: Heads up — onboarding handshake for Peregrine Systems reserved pool rp-9832 is provisioned. Need quota confirmation + autoscale thresholds before warmup load test tonight at 22:00 UTC. @tj_ops @devon_se FYI.
capacity-bot: reserved pool rp-9832 created in us-west-2. GPUs: 12 A100s. Current quota: vGPU=48, CPUs=384. Link: https://console.redwood/rp/rp-9832

tj_ops: Thanks. Proposal: autoscale min=2, target=6, max=18 to start. Peregrine expects bursty traffic but wants cost control. We will prime cache during warmup.
devon_se: Need to confirm their client TLS cert for private deployment; laura_success, did they finish the onboarding doc? I will set autoscale_policy=cpu_based with cool_down=120s.
laura_success: They uploaded certs yesterday. Enablement telco at 16:00 PT to walk the warmup script. I'll capture feedback and ask for success criteria (p99 target, error budget, UX notes).
henry_re: Renewal risk note — customer flagged churn if p99 > 350ms. Can we guarantee latency SLO in the canary? If not, recommend fallback to hosted small model during peak.
maria_cs: Our acceptance criteria: p99 < 300ms for 512-token prompts. If we can’t hit that in canary, they will delay commit. Ops — can you add fallback route to model-lite if p99 crosses threshold?
devon_se: Affirmative. Adding routing policy: primary->model-prod-8b (rp-9832), fallback->model-lite-2b in-region. Also adding alert: p99_latency > 300ms for 5m -> auto_shift=1.
tj_ops: Load test plan: 30m ramp to 800rps simulating burst windows, then 10m peak. Run from our k8s load harness. Command we’ll use:```vegeta attack -duration=30m -rate=800 -targets=./peregrine_targets.txt | vegeta report```
capacity-bot: Load test scheduled: 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z. Test run id: lt-239001. Notifying eng-oncall.
eng-oncall: Acked. I will be on watch for tail latency and OOMs, will escalate to eng-runtime if we see queue depth > 80%.
devon_se: Also adding KV cache priming step: run prime script to hit top 200 prefixes before load. I'll drop the prefix list in the runbook channel.
laura_success: I’ll join the warmup and take notes. Post-run I’ll capture product feedback (integration pain points, docs gaps) and open a CS ticket with actions.
henry_re: If load test shows degradation, run a quick smoke of the fallback route to verify output quality. Any quality regressions -> tag product and research for RCA.
maria_cs: :thumbsup: Final checklist: certs verified, autoscale policy set, fallback route added, KV priming in runbook, load test scheduled, enablement call at 16:00 PT. Ping me immediately if anything blocks.
devon_se: One more: tagging the pool with customer=peregrine and renewal_window=Q4-2026.
capacity-bot: Tagging complete. rp-9832 tags updated.
